tbesh_html:
1) alarm, signal, sound of tempest, shout, shout or blast of war or alarm or joy
1a) alarm of war, war-cry, battle-cry
1b) blast (for march)
1c) shout of joy (with religious impulse)
1d) shout of joy (in general)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: clamor, i.e. acclamation of joy or a battle-cry; especially clangorof trumpets, as an alarum
strongs_1890.kjv_def: alarm, blow(-ing) (of, the) (trumpets), joy, jubile, loud noise, rejoicing, shout(-ing), (high, joyful) sound(-ing).
